title: Frame Return Refund Amount — Northgate Optical Accounting Standard
content:
**Frame return refund — Northgate Optical.** The frame return refund is the frame charge less every credit already posted against it, refunded in full.

**Net frame charge.** The frame charge is the frame charge of the original order (remake number 0). Every credit already posted against the frame charge — a vision plan frame allowance included — is subtracted to give the net frame charge.

**Amounts kept and the refund.** The frame return refund is worked out in this order: the frame restocking deduction and the lab shipping handling amount are added together and the frame courtesy is taken off that sum, never below zero; that amount is kept out of the net frame charge; the result is floored at zero and rounded to the cent once.

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Frame restocking deduction | 0.00 |
| Lab shipping handling amount | 0.00 |
| Frame courtesy | 0.00 |
| Amount kept | 0.00 |
| Refund | the net frame charge, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical jobs)

| Frame charge | Credits already against it | Net frame charge | Frame return refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 89.99 | none | 89.99 | 89.99 |
| 150.00 | VSP frame allowance 130.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| 95.00 | Davis Vision frame allowance 95.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

In the third case the plan already covered the whole frame, so there is nothing left on the frame charge to refund to the member.
